simple.meaning: רַבָּה (Rabbâh) appears 15 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Deuteronomy, Joshua, 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Jeremiah, and 2 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 3:11. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, city, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רַבָּה (H7237) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows רַבָּה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: רַבָּה (Rabbâh) / H7237 is tracked through Deuteronomy 3:11, Joshua 13:25, Joshua 15:60, 2 Samuel 11:1. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.
Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.
David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

definitions.short: Rabbah , the name of two places in Palestine, East and West
definitions.full: H7237. Rabbah רַבָּה proper name, of a location Rabba (properly great or populous , that is, city); — 1 capital of Ammonites explicitly , עַמּוֺן בְּנֵי רַבַּת 2Sam 12:26-27 , 17:27 ; Deut 3:11 ; Jer 49:2 ; Ezek 21:25 ; רַבָּה alone 2Sam 11:1 || 1Chr 20:1 (twice in verse), Amos 1:14 ; Jer 49:3 ; Ezek 25:5 ; Josh 13:25 (P); with ה locative רַבָּ֑תָה 2Sam 12:29 ; in Greek Period Philadelphia , Lag onom 215, 94; 219, 82 (but Ραββατμανα Polyb v. 71.4 ), modern Ammâ 132-Janmiles northeast from Heshbon, 28 2-Janmiles east of Jordan; compare Buhl Geogr.260 ;- ᵐ5 Ραββαθ , Ραββα 2 הָרַבָּה city in Judah Josh 15:60 (P), site unknow; — ᵐ5 Σωθηβα , A ᵐ5 L Αρεββα .
